tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza shrī badzra yo gi ni ye/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs bla ma dang / /rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo mchod pa'i sbyin sreg gi /cho ga'i lag len ma nor don tshang spel/ /'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ gsang sngags kyi nus pa byung ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ thab kyi gzhi sa stegs gru bzhi 'thas par/ de'i steng thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun pa btab la/ dbus nas khru gang bskor ba ni thab kyi tshad/ de'i nang du sor bzhi pa gnyis bskor ba ni kha khyer dang mu ran te/ de la rdo rje phreng ba kha zum pas bskor ba bris/ de'i mtha' gru bzhir thig gdab la kha chag sor bzhi byas pa'i nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje kha zum pas mtshan pa bris/ zlum bskor nang ma'i nang nas lte ba'i bar gyi tshad des/ zlum bskor dang shar nub gnyis kyi tshangs thig 'dzoms steng bzung nas shar nub g.yas g.yon du rtags byas la shar gyi tshangs thig zlum thig 'dzoms steng nas lho nub dang nub byang du thig gdab/ lho nub kyi rtags steng nas nub byang du thig gdab/ de bzhin/ nub kyi tshangs zlum 'dzoms steng nas/ shar lho dang byang shar thig gdab/ de nas/ shar lho dang byang shar gyi rtags steng gdab pas chos 'byung bsnol ma 'byung zhing / slar yang de'i nang du sor gang tsam gyi thig re btab/ chos 'byung gi re kha dkar po/ nang thams cad rdul tshon dmar pos bkang ste/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du bris/ dbus su nyi ma'i gdan la tshom bu dmar po bkod/

thab kyi kha khyer bud shing srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam po'am tsher ma can ma yin pa'i bud shing brtsigs la/ de'i 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig bshams/ rang nyid zhal shar du phyogs pa'i g.yon thab kyi g.yas su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dam rdzas lnga bdun gsum la sogs pa dang / bskang pa'i gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rigs sogs so so'i phyag len ltar dang / me lha la gtor ma zlum gtor gcig rnams bshams/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du/ yam shing ni shing 'o ma can zhes pa lcang dkar la sogs pa gas grum med pa sbom phra mtheb chen nas mtheb chung gi bar dang / ring thung sor brgyad pa'am/ khru gang pa'am/ sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i rtse mo mar dang sbrang rtsi dang dri bzang gis byugs pa dang / 'bru mar ram/ mar bzhu ba/ til dang / las kyis shi ba'i ba lang gi sha dum bur btub cing brngos pa la chang la bdud rtsi'i ril bu btab pas sbags pa dang / zho mar phye gsum dang sbrang bu ram rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog ku sha dur ba dang / nas dang / gro dang / 'o ma dang / 'bras dang / sran ma dang / ja ti la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs bzhag pa'o/ /til nas 'bru sna tshogs kyi bar zangs sder sogs snod bzang por bkod nas bzhag go /ku sha dang yam shing la snod med par mchod gzhi'i steng bkod pa'o/ /sgrub pa po'i mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgang gzar blug gzar gnyis kha sbyar la bzhag dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba ku sha'i 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/ 'thor nas/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ spor lde khru gang tsam pa yang bshams/ sgrub pa po dang thab kyi bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol yang bshams pa ni sbyor ba'i chos so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/

/dang po ni/ byed ran kyi tshe/ sgrub pa po kha shar phyogs su bltas la/ gos dkar po gyon la/ sdig pa zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ skyabs yul gsal 'debs nas brtsams te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod cing / rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hreṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces brjod pa'i bar kho bos byas pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin bya ba'am/ rang gang byed kyi bdag bskyed byas la/ de nas bsang chu byin rlabs ni/ sumbha nis bsang / swa bha was sbyangs/ shaṃ las dung chos dri ma med pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las bsang chus rdzas rnams kyi bgegs dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing sumbha ni nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlab cing / de nas bsang chu ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyi thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor nas/ sumbha nis bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ argham̐/ pā dyam̐/ puṣpam̐/ dhu pam̐/ a lo ke gandham̐/ nai wi dyam̐/ shapda/ āḥhūm̐/ om̐ shrī swāhā/ om̐ dziṃ swāhā/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod cing byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ yang thab la bsang chu gtor la/ sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/

hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang / zab tu khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing / phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ ram̐ las bgrang 'phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha ra skyes la zhon pa sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas gendhi 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing / tshangs pa'i skud pa dang kriṣṇa sa ri'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs dang dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hyi hi mahā bhu ta de bā ri ṣi dī dza sa tta ma gṛ hi to mahā asmani sanni hi to bha wa agna ye e hye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ nas/ shapda'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga/ nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsang chu gtor zhing / sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /hūm̐ las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yis kyang dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra sa twa ā/ ma ma shantiṃ kurbantu swāhā/ zhes brjod cing ku sha'i rtse mo phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas bskor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbul/ de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su gong du me sbar bar bshad kyang / phyag len la/ skabs 'dir mdzad pas/ spor lde sbar nas/ thab la g.yon phyogs su lan gsum bskor zhing / oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ zhes pas thab nang gi ting lo sbar/ me ni rdo dang lcags rtsub pa las byung ba ma yin pa/ rgyun bzhag gi me 'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa las byung ba'o/ /phus mi brdab/ rlung g.yab kyis sbar ro/ /de nas yam shing gzhan dang bcas pas me legs par 'bar du bcug cing / mar blug gzar gsum dang dzwa la'i sngags kyis me gso/ de nas me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam dgang blug gi kha la yang ram̐ bsam la/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ gzar bu bdun gyis dgang blug mar gyis bkang / oṃ agne ye a di bya a di bya a bhi sha a bhi sha mahā shrī ha bya ka bya/ bha ha na ye/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig gi nyams chag sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/

zhes pa lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ skabs 'dir me pra brtag cing / ngan na/ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu gtor/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la thab la lan gsum bskor/ oṃ agna ye/ zhes pa kun la sbyar ba'i/ arghaṃ nas/ shapda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ agna ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍa kas dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ yam shing nas dza ti la sogs pa'i 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi bar rim pa bzhin lag g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas phul/ dang por yam shing la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la ya bo dhi bṛkṣa ya swāhā/ mar la/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badzra ye swāhā/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la/ oṃ ma da na ba la pañtsa ā mṛ ta swāhā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba sam̐ po ta ye swāhā/ ku sha la/ oṃ badzra a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ durba la/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swāhā/ nas la/ oṃ mahā bāe gā ye swāhā/ gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma ra ya swāhā/ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ya swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ mahā bā la ya swāhā/ dza ti la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs la/ oṃ mahā shrī pha la brta ni swāhā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas rnams sngags dang bcas pa lan bdun re'i mjug tu/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig brjod cing dbul/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas nas/ mar blug gzar gang thab nang du blugs la/ oṃ agna dzwa la ram̐/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ ces brjod pa rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/

/gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar yang me gso ba'i phyir bud shing brtsigs pa dang / mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams kha gsos la/ mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin rlabs byas/ de nas thab la bsang chu gtor zhing / sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ zhes pa nas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar las/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /sogs shlau ka gsum dang / oṃ badzra yo gi ni e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ phyi nang gi mchod bstod bya/ oṃ badzra yo gi ni ye di bya di bya bi shuddhe mahā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gong bzhin mar gyi byon zan dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la thab la lan gsum bskor/ de nas mdun bskyed ltar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar bya zhing / de nas/ oṃ badzra yo gi ni sa pa ri wa ra/ sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / oṃ badzra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /sogs shlau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ badzra yo gi ni/ oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la bo dhi brikṣa ya sarba pā paṃ shantiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pas yam shing / de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba las/ bo dhi prikṣa'i gnas su/ mar sogs rdzas so so'i sngags bcug la 'bul/

bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum byas tshe/ rdzas til lam yungs kar gang rung la/ oṃ gsum ma la bcu cha'i grangs khri tsho bzhi grangs 'dzin dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ nyi ma lnga'i dang po la cho ga gcig dang / bar ba gsum la cho ga gnyis gnyis/ lnga pa la snga chog ste cho ga brgyad la/ sngags lnga stong re re bzla dgos shing / bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams brgya dang bcu re 'bul dgos pas/ dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yong bas/ sngags lnga brgya re song mtshams rdzas rnams bcu tshan pa re 'bul zhing / bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs spel tshig lan re brjod/ thog mtha' gnyis gong bzhin la/ bar gyi bcu tshan dgu po oṃ gsum ma 'ba' zhig gis 'bul yang lce ma bde ba la sogs pas/ nyi ma bdun du byed dgos byung tshe/ cho ga bcu gnyis su byas pa'i cho ga re la sngags gsum stong lnga brgya re bzla zhing / bsreg rdzas rnams sngags gsum brgya re song mtshams su 'bul ba sogs gong gi rigs 'gre shes par bya zhing / de ltar byas pas sngags bzhi khri lhag tsam 'gro'o/ /lo/ /de yang bsreg rdzas rnams mar dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zas mchog gsum zhal du/ ku sha dang durba'i myu gu dbu'i gtsug tor la/ 'bras bu la sogs pa gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu phul bar bsam mo/ /mthar gang ba'i sbyin sreg byon zan bzhin mar lan bdun spel tshig dang bcas pa 'bul/ de nas gong bzhin/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams bya/ bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum sogs byas tshe/ de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg sogs gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ kho bos byas pa'i dkyil mchog gi gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas la/ nyi ma dang po'i thun dang / rjes ma'i thun/ nyi ma bar ma'i dgong thun rnams la gtor bsngo rgyas pa las/ 'di nyid kyi gtor bsngo dkyil chog ltar bya zhing / spro na bskang ba bstod pa sogs skabs dang sbyar la so so'i phyag len bzhin bya/

nyi ma bar ma'i snga thun la/ byin rlabs nas bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa'i bar dkyil chog ltar gyis phul/ de nas gur zhal dur khrod bdag po las mgon/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba bstod pa nas/ de'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi bar gtor bsngo 'bring po ltar bya/ de nas he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha bskang / oṃ khyed kyis sems can don mdzod/ sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba cung zad blangs pa/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha rnams su thig le bya/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mar blug gzar gang thab tu blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ me lha sngar bzhin zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i skur gyur/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i sngags dang bcas pas lan ji ltar rigs pa phul rjes gong bzhin spel tshig dang bcas pas 'bul/ sngar ltar mchod bstod byas la/ me lha'i gtor ma de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hri/ lan gsum gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ agha ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas sngar bzhin phyi nang gi bstod pa byas la/ oṃ agna ye badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ slar yang yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang / gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa la gshegs gsol byas la/ de nas rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ zhes sogs nas/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsanḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/

ces pa'i bar gyis go cha dgod/ sumbha ni tshar gnyis brjod cing sdigs mdzub phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor du bstan la mtshams dam sngags kyis bsrung / hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin hūm̐/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pas dga' ba gsum dran par byas nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs nas/ bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pas smon lam btab la/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba/ /sogs 'di nyid kyi bkra shis dang / gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis brjod la me tog gi char dbab cing thal ba rnams chu bor dor/ las kyi rjes mi sngon par bsdu'o/ /de dag gis ni rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gsal bar bstan zin to/ /de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sbyin sreg cho ga mkha' spyod gsang lam 'di/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chen po yi/ /thugs sras rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / /'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi/ /zhabs zung bsten pa'i sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /rigs dang chos kyi bu sogs dad ldan gyi/ /slob ma rnams dang rang nyid nyams len phyir/ /lcags 'brug khrums kyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs la/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi /yang rtse bkra shis brtsegs kyi khang bzang du/ /sbyar ba 'di yi yi ge'i 'du byed mkhan/ /rang gi mchod g.yog dge slong rdo rje 'dzin/ /rnam dpyod blo ldan ngag dbang dpal bzang gis/
